title: Portable Windows Staging Auto Pilot runtime governance

phases.objective: Prove the portable Windows Staging launcher is deterministic, fail-closed, isolated from Production, and able to build the application image with its canonical runtime manifest.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Start-Staging-One-Click.cmd on the exact eligible main commit
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher accepts only the exact eligible SHA, prevents overlapping runs, repairs protected line-ending drift, builds the Staging image with canonical-manifest.mjs, starts internal-only services, records actionable health diagnostics, and never mutates Production or provider DNS.
steps: Resolve the exact main SHA and read the Staging eligibility Workflow Run for that same SHA.
Acquire the single-run lock and fail closed if another launcher is active.
Normalize only manifest-protected line endings, reject real working-tree content changes, and verify raw SHA-256 bytes.
Validate the root-context Staging Docker build, including canonical-manifest.mjs at /canonical-manifest.mjs.
Start the internal Docker topology, wait for health, capture service logs on failure, and expose only the explicitly allowed Cloudflare Tunnel origins.
assertions: A missing, running, failed, or mismatched eligibility Workflow Run never deploys the SHA.
Concurrent Auto Pilot runs are rejected and no second Compose operation is started.
Line-ending repair cannot hide non-line-ending content changes and manifest hashes remain deterministic.
The Staging image contains the canonical manifest required by activationDynamicEvidenceLegacy.js.
No Production hostname, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, migration apply, or database mutation is authorized by this journey.

phases.objective: Prove live non-production Windows deployment and Cloudflare Tunnel reachability after the local Docker image and credentials are available.
blockers: Live Windows Docker Desktop and dedicated Staging Tunnel credentials are external to repository CI.

phases.objective: Prove recovery from Docker Desktop restart, port-proxy failure, interrupted Compose startup, and repeated Auto Pilot invocation without database loss.
Validate the exact dev.mad4b.com and mcp_dev.mad4b.com non-production canary after a live tunnel run.
blockers: A live dedicated Cloudflare Tunnel token and operator approval are required.

phases.objective: Keep Production outside the Portable Staging deployment contract.
blockers: This feature explicitly forbids Production deployment and Hostinger mutation.
